objective: Test what independent information permits recovery from correlated verifier errors.
context: Finite binary propositions, committee votes, parity witnesses and independently supplied anchors. Guarded controller trusts independent relations, abstains without anchored path. Heuristic loss weights are not calibrated posteriors.

steps.name: Define observations
steps.description: Separate public votes, edges and anchors from sealed truth.

steps.name: Model correlated errors
steps.description: Distinguish independent vote flips from shared bias.

steps.name: Solve finite assignments
steps.description: Compute weighted disagreement and compare target labels.

steps.name: Apply provenance guard
steps.description: Determine whether an independent anchored path supports a decision.

steps.name: Evaluate corruption controls
steps.description: Compare independent and vote-derived evidence and anchor failures.

specific_questions.prompt: Prove global bit-flip ambiguity for unanchored consistent parity graphs.
Derive an exact label from a trusted anchor and an independent parity path; explain conditions for abstention.
Construct a unanimous but systematically incorrect committee and specify what independent evidence could resolve it.

native_verifier: Control-Harness src/evals/broken_verifier_gym.py finite solver and sealed scorer.
